lines.text: Every night, small, fast boats run dark toward our coast.
Conventional patrols take time to launch, and rough water slows them down. By the time they arrive, the target is gone.
lines.say: Conventional patrols take time to launch... and rough water slows them down. By the time they arrive... the target is gone.

lines.text: One: it gets there first. Flying on foils at up to 150 knots.
lines.say: One. It gets there first. Flying on foils at up to one hundred fifty knots.

lines.text: Two: it sees the threat. Its sensors scan and identify the vessel from a safe distance.
lines.say: Two. It sees the threat. Its sensors scan and identify the vessel... from a safe distance.

lines.text: Three: it stays on target. Marlin holds the track and streams a live picture to responders, until they make the stop.
lines.say: Three. It stays on target. Marlin holds the track, and streams a live picture to responders... until they make the stop.

lines.text: Get there. See it. Stay on it.
